findings.title: Promoted record copies claimedIdentityRef instead of the port's resolved identityRef
findings.trigger: Caller supplies a claimedIdentityRef whose declared binding field differs from the port's resolution
findings.consequence: Stored record could carry a declared binding inconsistent with the authority store; no bypass today (only resolved.binding is read; minting invariant holds); future slices reading identityRef.binding without the port could be misled
findings.verification: grep shows sole .binding read is resolved.binding at L195; source read of promoteToHuman
findings.recommendation: On success write resolved.identityRef instead of input.claimedIdentityRef; fix at B05 integration, no rework of this slice
